correctness.rationale: All 260 nonempty faces of the Petersen 2-independence complex are exhaustively generated. A 128-pair staged toggle matching is checked cell-by-cell and its reversed Hasse orientation is acyclic. Exactly four critical cells remain in dimensions 0,2,3,3. Exact signed gradient-path evaluation gives boundary coefficients (-1,-1), so a degree-one 3-cell attachment contracts the 2-sphere and the remaining 3-cell yields S^3.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical symmetric nonchordal cubic graph, and r=2 is the first genuinely higher-independence case. An exact homotopy classification provides a natural benchmark outside the graph families covered by the main general theorems and shows that the sphere phenomenon persists here for a nonchordal test object.
